_readme: Every prospect homepage Momentum 360 has built, as of 2026-08-18. Supersedes philly-100-completed.json, which froze at the original 100 on 2026-08-05 and so left the 138 later builds invisible to the radar. Used as (a) the exclusion list so discovery never re-pitches a business we already built for, (b) the reconciliation source that marks a registry row lifecycle=built so it leaves the rebuild queue and picks up the -40 priority de-rank, and (c) the dashboard's rebuilt-site portfolio. Phone numbers, email addresses and street addresses are deliberately omitted - only a has_public_email flag is kept. The verified-contact sheet stays out of Git.
_source: Momentum 360 - 238 Call-Ready Businesses - 2026-08-13 (Google Sheet, tabs merged; QA status as of 2026-08-16). Domains resolved against 12_Brain/state/radar/registry.json.

_fields.domain: The business's own domain as the radar registry knows it. Empty means this build was never discovered by the radar - most of the original 100 came from the completed-100 PDF, not from OpenStreetMap.
_fields.phone_source_host: Host of the page used to VERIFY THE PHONE NUMBER. Often a directory (BBB, YellowPages, an NPI lookup, a state site). This is NOT the business's own website and must never be used as their domain.
_fields.qa_state: passed = design-verified 2026-08-16. fix = did not pass or was never reviewed; see fix_reason.

fix_reason.design-review-pending: Built and looks finished, but never went through the design-QA pass the original 100 had. An unreviewed build, not a known defect.
fix_reason.webgl-fallback: Renders black without the ?forcegl query parameter. A real production defect - a prospect opening the bare URL sees a black page.
fix_reason.placeholder-concept: Concept preview held at qa_ready=hold because no verified first-party source or address was found at build time. All 47 share one unfinished hero. Fill the copy or drop.
fix_reason.hero-not-authentic: Hero art is generated, not a real photograph of the business.

_fields.call_priority: SHOW / REVIEW / DO NOT SHOW, carried from the call sheet.
_fields.duplicate_of: This build duplicates an earlier build of the same business by another lane.
_fields.live_url: The private noindex concept. Not a client-approved production site.
